claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive rider changes the damage type of an existing weapon hit without changing its amount or attack resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt activation deterministically restores the thrown item to the wielder's hand after its save-gated damage resolves.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.
